## Why Join a Community?

Learning to code is more than just syntax—it's about joining a global community of researchers, developers, and educators who share knowledge openly. These communities offer:

- **Learning opportunities**: Workshops, tutorials, and mentorship
- **Networking**: Connect with researchers and professionals worldwide
- **Support**: Get help when you're stuck on a problem
- **Contribution**: Give back by helping others and improving tools

## R & Data Science Communities

| Community | Focus | Link |
|-----------|-------|------|
| [rOpenSci](https://ropensci.org/) | Scientific R packages & peer review | [ropensci.org](https://ropensci.org/) |
| [R/Medicine](https://r-medicine.org/) | R in healthcare & medical research | [r-medicine.org](https://r-medicine.org/) |
| [The Carpentries](https://carpentries.org/) | Teaching foundational coding skills | [carpentries.org](https://carpentries.org/) |

| [Posit Community](https://forum.posit.co/) | RStudio/Quarto user forums | [forum.posit.co](https://forum.posit.co/) |
| [Latin-R](https://latin-r.com/) | R community in Latin America | [latin-r.com](https://latin-r.com/) |

## Conferences & Events

Attending conferences is a great way to learn about new methods, packages, and connect with the community.

| Conference | Focus | Website |
|------------|-------|---------|
| [useR!](https://www.r-project.org/conferences/) | The official R conference | [r-project.org](https://www.r-project.org/conferences/) |
| [posit::conf](https://posit.co/conference/) | RStudio/Posit annual conference | [posit.co/conference](https://posit.co/conference/) |
| [R/Medicine](https://r-medicine.org/) | R in medical research | [r-medicine.org](https://r-medicine.org/) |
| [Latin-R](https://latin-r.com/) | R in Latin America | [latin-r.com](https://latin-r.com/) |

## Ways to Get Involved

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### Start Small

- **Follow `#rstats`** on social media (Mastodon, Twitter/X, LinkedIn)
- **Join a forum** like Posit Community or Stack Overflow
- **Attend a local meetup** — many cities have R user groups
- **Watch recordings** from past conferences (many are free on YouTube)
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### Level Up

- **Report bugs** when you find them in packages
- **Write documentation** or improve existing docs
- **Create tutorials** or blog posts about what you've learned
- **Become an instructor** with The Carpentries
- **Review packages** for rOpenSci
:::

:::

| Resource | Description | Link |
|----------|-------------|------|

::: {.callout-tip}
## Start Today!

Pick one community from this list and join it this week. Even just lurking and reading discussions will help you learn and feel connected to the broader data science world.
:::
